Liga Uruguaya de Basquetbol (Genius LiveStats)

Source: R/genius_competitions.R
lub_competition.Rd

Convenience wrappers binding the Genius family to the Liga Uruguaya de Basquetbol (men's; Genius ORG FUBB, LiveStats ORG FUBB). Season rule: END year; Genius year + 1 (2025-26 = 2026).

  • lub_competitions(): every competition of the FUBB org, with its END-year season (genius_competitions()).

  • lub_schedule(): every match of one season (genius_schedule()).

  • lub_team_box(), lub_player_box(), lub_pbp(), lub_shots(): one finished game (genius_team_box(), genius_player_box(), genius_pbp(), genius_shots()).

Usage

lub_competitions(return_parsed = TRUE)

lub_schedule(season = NULL, comp_id = NULL, round_number = -1, return_parsed = TRUE)

lub_team_box(match_id, return_parsed = TRUE)

lub_player_box(match_id, return_parsed = TRUE)

lub_pbp(match_id, return_parsed = TRUE)

lub_shots(match_id, return_parsed = TRUE)

Arguments

season

END-year season (see the season rule). NULL (default) = the newest season the org lists.

comp_id

Genius competition id; skips the season lookup (needed when the label rule matches several competitions).

round_number

Round to list; -1 (default) lists every round.

match_id

Genius match id (match_id of lub_schedule()) of a game of this competition.

return_parsed

Parse into a tibble (default TRUE); FALSE returns the raw list.

Value

The base function's hoopR_data tibble, same columns and types (the raw list when return_parsed = FALSE), one table per function:

lub_competitions()

The columns of genius_competitions():

col_nametypedescription
orgcharacterORG code the request used (the hosted ORG, or the LiveStats ORG for the /u/ shell).
comp_idintegerGenius competition id (compId): one per org competition-season; the {compId} of hosted and data/competition paths
labelcharacterCompetition label as the org typed it, free text in any language: may or may not carry a season ('BASKET LEAGUE 2019 - 20', '1st division', 'Kypello Elladas' (in Greek script) = Greek Cup, 'Mavroskoufeia' (in Greek script) = Mavroskoufeia youth tournament)
league_idintegerGenius league id of the org (ESAKE = 115; IBBA has two: 187 and 549)
yearintegerGenius season year of the competition: the START year of a two-year season (BNXT '2023-2024' = 2023), the year itself for a calendar season. null when the page gives none
seasonintegersdv END-year season of the competition (2026 = 2025-26) from the label span, else the Genius year; null when no rule applies. See season_rule.
season_rulecharacterWhich rule produced season: 'label span', 'genius year + 1 (split)', 'genius year (calendar)', 'label year (calendar)' or 'unknown'.
selectedlogicalTrue for the competition the hosted chooser pre-selects (the org's default, not always the newest).

lub_schedule()

The columns of genius_schedule():

col_nametypedescription
match_idintegerFrom the block id extfix_<id>. Genius match id: the {matchId} of data.json and /u/; one global sequence across every Genius customer (~0.3 M in 2016, ~2.9 M in Oct 2026)
link_match_idintegerMatch id of the block's /match/<id>/summary link; equals match_id (the capture refuses a page where it does not); null when the org hides match pages (FFBB)
comp_idintegerCompId of the match link, or of the team links when the org hides match pages (FFBB); equals the {compId} asked for. A 'To be determined' slot (no team or match link) takes the {compId} the page's other blocks prove
orgcharacterORG code of the match link (or the team links, as comp_id)
statuscharacterStatus from the block class STATUS_*: COMPLETE, SCHEDULED, POSTPONED, ...

venue_idintegerGenius venue id (the /venue/{id} of hosted pages); null when the venue is plain text (FFBB)
venue_namecharacterVenue name as entered (local script)
home_team_idintegerHome team: Genius team id (warehouse key space, global across orgs and seasons; the /team/{id} of hosted pages, the tid of the widget, the teamId of data/competition). data.json carries no team id: join on name/code
home_team_namecharacterHome team full name
home_team_codecharacterHome team code (local script possible)
home_scoreintegerHome points; null before tip-off (typed integer only on a route whose 3 sampled rows were all played)
away_team_idintegerAway team: Genius team id (warehouse key space, global across orgs and seasons; the /team/{id} of hosted pages, the tid of the widget, the teamId of data/competition). data.json carries no team id: join on name/code
away_team_namecharacterAway team full name
away_team_codecharacterAway team code (local script possible)
away_scoreintegerAway points; null before tip-off (typed integer only on a route whose 3 sampled rows were all played)

lub_pbp()

The columns of genius_pbp():

col_nametypedescription
match_idintegerGenius match id of the game. data.json does not carry it: it is the match_id asked for, stamped by the runtime (the global match sequence shared by every Genius customer).
row_indexintegerPosition of the action in the feed order, 0 = the newest action by game time (normally the game end row). The feed is not strictly sorted by action_number, so sort on action_number for entry order.
action_numberintegerAction sequence number, unique within the game (gaps where actions were deleted); a shot joins its play-by-play row on it. Null in the 2014-15 feed.
previous_actionintegeraction_number of the linked earlier action (the shot an assist or rebound belongs to); null when the feed sends an empty string.
periodintegerPeriod number; restarts at 1 for the first overtime (read it with period_type).
period_typecharacterPeriod type: REGULAR or OVERTIME.
gtcharacterGame clock, 'mm:ss' remaining in the period
clockcharacterGame clock with hundredths, 'mm:ss:cc' remaining in the period; absent in older feeds (the 2014-15 WBBL sample has gt only)
tnointegerTeam number within this game: 1 = the team listed first (home on the hosted schedule and widget), 2 = the other, 0 = no team. In-game only: not a team id.
pnointegerPlayer number within this game, the key of the team's player map; 0 = no player. In-game only: not a person id and not the shirt number.
playercharacterPlayer display name; ” when no player
shirt_numbercharacterPlayer shirt number (string); ” when no player
first_namecharacterGiven name in the competition's own script and spelling (Greek, Hebrew, Czech, ... as entered)
family_namecharacterFamily name in the competition's own script
international_first_namecharacterGiven name in Latin script
international_family_namecharacterFamily name in Latin script (often upper case)
scoreboard_namecharacterShort display name ('T. Nichols'), in the local script when the org enters one
action_typecharacterAction type: 2pt, 3pt, freethrow, rebound, assist, turnover, steal, block, foul, foulon (foul drawn), substitution, timeout, jumpball, period, game, headcoachchallenge
sub_typecharacterAction subtype, free-text code per actionType: shot type for 2pt/3pt (layup, drivinglayup, jumpshot, pullupjumpshot, turnaroundjumpshot, ...), 'in'/'out' for substitutions, 'start'/'end' for period and game, foul kind for fouls; empty string when none
qualifiercharacterQualifier codes of the action joined with commas (pointsinthepaint, fromturnover, 2ndchance, fastbreak, blocked, ...); null when none.
successinteger1 = made / successful, 0 = missed (shots, free throws); 1 for other actions
scoringinteger1 when the action is a scoring attempt (shot or free throw), else 0
score_1integerTeam 1 score after the action, always an integer (the feed sends a string in most games).
score_2integerTeam 2 score after the action, always an integer (the feed sends a string in most games).
leadintegerScore margin after the action, team 1 minus team 2 (negative when team 2 leads)

lub_shots()

The columns of genius_shots():

col_nametypedescription
match_idintegerGenius match id of the game. data.json does not carry it: it is the match_id asked for, stamped by the runtime (the global match sequence shared by every Genius customer).
tnointegerTeam number within this game: 1 = the team listed first (home on the hosted schedule and widget), 2 = the other, 0 = no team. In-game only: not a team id.
pnointegerPlayer number within this game, the key of the team's player map; 0 = no player. In-game only: not a person id and not the shirt number.
action_numberintegerAction sequence number, unique within the game (gaps where actions were deleted); a shot joins its play-by-play row on it. Null in the 2014-15 feed.
periodintegerPeriod number; restarts at 1 for the first overtime (read it with period_type).
period_typecharacterPeriod type: REGULAR or OVERTIME.
action_typecharacterShot value: 2pt or 3pt
sub_typecharacterShot type (layup, drivinglayup, jumpshot, pullupjumpshot, dunk, ...)
resultintegerShot result: 1 = made, 0 = missed.
xnumericCourt x, PERCENT of the full court length (0-100, float), along the long axis. Not normalised to one basket: a team attacks one end in periods 1-2 and the other end in periods 3-4 (ESAKE 2902690: team 1 mean x 90 and 86 in P1-P2, 11 and 19 in P3-P4). Which end x = 0 is, and which end team 1 starts at, are unverified
ynumericCourt y, PERCENT of the full court width (0-100, float), across the court (observed 1.7-97.2). Origin side unverified
playercharacterShooter's display name as the org enters it, in the local script when it uses one.
shirt_numbercharacterShooter's shirt number (string)

Details

The season's competition is picked from the FUBB chooser by the label rule include = liga uruguaya|^lub, exclude = amistosos|femenina (case-insensitive); cups and play-offs have their own comp_id. Several matching competitions raise hoopR_bad_request (pass comp_id); none raises hoopR_no_data.

Genius match ids are one global sequence shared by every customer and data.json names no competition, so each game alias checks the id on the game's LiveStats shell (/u/FUBB/<match_id>/: one extra request per game, cached per process for an hour): its competition name must pass the label rule. Another org's game, a cup or play-off game of FUBB, or a shell request that fails twice (or names no competition) raises hoopR_asset_fetch. The base genius_*() function reads any game unchecked.

Access, proxy and error notes: see genius_game().
